# Qualify retained continuous-mapping artifact evidence for delivery

Parent: #560 (lane B, CP8)

Predecessors: #669, #670, exhausted #672, and exhausted #678

Coordination: #559

## Problem and inherited result

#678 exhausted its third attempt only because its final verifier did not allow
the `sdk/dist/` tree generated by the authorized SDK package gate. Before that
verifier, all eight remaining artifact gates and their postchecks returned 0,
including SDK packaging and Chromium 151.0.7922.34, Firefox 153.0, and WebKit
26.5 with matrix and mutation checks. The repository stayed clean; every tracked
byte differed from source checkpoint
`8708c9b998a484d49ccb17a803e79540ca13fcd6` only at the three authorized
scratch lineage paths; the six candidate files retained their accepted hashes;
and the preserved #672 target identity remained exact.

The final verifier correctly returned 1 because 77 regular files now exist under
`/tmp/issue678-attempt2-candidate-source/sdk/dist/`. #678 has no PRE-PIN PASS and
is closed. This successor owns only read-only disposition of those generated
outputs and the complete retained evidence, followed by separately reviewed
promotion and delivery. It carries the successful gates without rerunning them.

## Ownership and immutable scope

Sol HIGH coordinates checkpoints, GitHub synchronization, promotion, PR, merge,
and cleanup. Luna HIGH `/root/issue583_luna_impl` performs the single bounded
read-only evidence classification. Astra LOW performs scope, evidence, promotion,
exact-head/current-main, and delivery review.

All predecessor files and paths are immutable. Product source, dependencies,
locks, scripts, fixtures, browser results, artifacts, pins, lineage, and generated
SDK output are frozen. Do not run Cargo, npm, Node, browsers, builders, package
scripts, tests, or qualification gates. Do not clean or repair any predecessor
path. No `.ll`, `.s`, compiler stream, binary, target, browser payload, generated
SDK file, or raw evidence enters Git; Git receives only compact decisions and,
after separate authorization, the three pin/lineage edits.

## Review, promotion, and delivery

Astra LOW must return EVIDENCE PASS before any repository edit. PASS only means
the retained candidate is qualified; it authorizes no promotion by itself. Root
must append an exact promotion/post-pin amendment, push and synchronize it, and
obtain fresh Astra LOW scope PASS. That amendment may edit only:

- `hosts/host-web/web/miso-engine-v1-audio-worklet-artifact.sha256`;
- `hosts/host-web/qualification/results.json`, only `candidateCommit` and
  `wasmSha256`;
- `hosts/host-web/BROWSER_DEPLOYMENT_MATRIX.md`, only regenerated lineage;
- this issue record and concise #559/#560 rows.

The post-pin stage runs one ordinary no-bypass build in fresh external paths and
requires all six files byte-identical to the qualified candidate. It does not
repeat browser or SDK qualification. Astra LOW then reviews exact head/current
main. Root opens one PR, waits for required qualification success, performs the
guarded merge review, merges, verifies post-main qualification, synchronizes
#669/#670/#679/#559/#560 and #349 accounting, and removes only clean delivered
worktrees. Failed predecessor worktrees and evidence remain until the delivered
artifact record is secure.

- All 77 `sdk/dist/` files are exactly classified with no other unexplained path.

- Complete evidence receives Astra LOW EVIDENCE PASS before promotion.
- Post-pin ordinary build byte-matches all six retained candidate files.
- Required PR and post-main qualification pass on immutable reviewed heads.
- Git contains no generated or compiler evidence payload.
